system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"- I have set my Android device to store all downloads on my SD card with 25gb of space yet when checking my device's storage the downloads are being stored there instead. I've cleared data and cache and verified the setting for the storage location."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! It sounds like you've done some great troubleshooting already. We recommend checking the app settings again to ensure the SD card is selected for downloads. Let us know how it goes!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address the issue or provide specific guidance for SD card storage on Android."}
